questions.q: What happened to Adas from Nineveh?
options: He embraced Islam even though the Prophet did not invite him
questions.explain: A man from Nineveh embraced Islam.

questions.q: What did a group of jinn do on hearing his Quran recitation?
options: Embraced Islam and went back to preach
questions.explain: Jinn are also beings with choice.

questions.q: Who escorted the Prophet SAW into Makkah, armed?
What did the Prophet SAW do in remembrance of Mut'im's favour?
options: Said he would release the captives for his sake
questions.explain: Do not forget the favours of non-Muslims.

questions.q: What is the lesson about living in a plural society?
options: Both sides guard sensitivities and cultivate relationships
questions.explain: Living in harmony in a plural society.

questions.q: How do we cooperate with people of other faiths?
options: On agreed matters without loosening tawhid

questions.q: We are charged with dealing with the world of the jinn.
questions.explain: False. Do not be too busy with the jinn world; leave ruqyah issues to specialists.

questions.q: The Quran should be heard in silence, not as background sound during chatter.
questions.explain: True. Ansitu, be silent and listen.

questions.q: Put these events in the right order.

items.text: A group of jinn embrace Islam
Stopping in the valley between Taif and Makkah
Mut'im and his sons escort him

questions.explain: He stopped at Nakhlah, the jinn embraced Islam, a messenger went to Al-Akhnas, Mut'im escorted him and announced his protection.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: A small group of three to nine
A being charged with responsibility who has free will
The fertile valley between Taif and Makkah

questions.explain: Nakhlah is a fertile valley, nafar a small group, ansitu be silent and listen, and mukallaf a being charged with responsibility.
